source_pin.note: J10eWebView.java at this HEAD ALSO carries the J10f getSettings routing and J10g getServiceWorkerController routing + sPackageInfo seed (layered into one file as the webview work evolved). A strict single-concern freeze should EITHER register the whole WebView-provider-enrichment unit once J10g is signed, OR split J10eWebView.java into J10eViewDelegate.java + J10eCookieManager.java first. This draft pins the file as-is and flags the split.

draft_entries.api: A launching Activity whose manifest declares a *.NoActionBar theme is themed by that theme (AppCompat sees windowActionBar=false) instead of the application's parent theme
draft_entries.mechanism: AppSchedulerBridge.nativeOnScheduleLaunchAbility overwrote/zeroed activityInfo.theme before scheduleTransaction; AOSP14 performLaunchActivity:3745 -> ActivityInfo.getThemeResource:1585 then fell back to applicationInfo.theme (parent Theme, windowActionBar=true) -> AppCompatDelegateImpl.createSubDecor double-installs a decor ActionBar -> IllegalStateException. J10dTheme.restore() restores activityInfo.theme = ManifestJsonFallback.activityTheme(pkg,name) right before scheduleTransaction.

draft_entries.api: A route-A WebView gets a functional provider: the ViewDelegate forwards View-level calls (setLayoutParams/setFrame/...) to the real WebView via PrivateAccess.super_*, and getCookieManager() returns a concrete (non-null) CookieManager
draft_entries.mechanism: J8 type-zero stub no-ops the ViewDelegate (WebView.mLayoutParams stays null -> ConstraintLayout/FrameLayout NPE) and returns null for the abstract CookieManager (NPE). J10eWebView re-seeds an enriched WebViewFactoryProvider: getViewDelegate forwards m->PrivateAccess.super_<m>, getCookieManager returns WlCookieManager.
